A note for every Claude session on this Mac, from the user's request: run heavy jobs (cargo build/test/bench, large compiles, app or benchmark runs) through `memgate` (~/.cargo/bin/memgate), e.g. `memgate -- cargo build`. It queues jobs across all sessions (2 at a time) and kills runaway memory use, so parallel agents can't crash the 24 GB Mac. `memgate status` shows the queue. The same rule is now in the user's global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.
